info.title: PartnerLink
info.description: Used to push a new membership to Lazada for proactively linking memberships.

get.description: Used to push a new membership to Lazada for proactively linking memberships.

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: app_key
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: Unique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: timestamp
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: sign_method
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: sign
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: Part of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click here for details)

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: member_name
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Name of member on partner side, to easier identify the membership on My Account pages

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: valid_from
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Valid from of this balance in RFC RFC3339 format. Ignore if this is no validity period for the balance

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: tier
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Customer’s tier in partner side, shown as-is

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: tier_expiry
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Expiry of the membership, shown as-is

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: p_uid
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: A unique identifier of the member on partner side, generated and stored at partner side, that identifies that member and will be referenced by Lazada in further communications.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: valid_to
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Valid to of this balance in RFC RFC3339 format. Ignore if this is no validity period for the balance

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: from_source
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Where does this user come from.LAZADA or PARTNER
